create.name: Vanessa Zuisei Goddard
create.bio:
Vanessa Zuisei Goddard is a lay Zen teacher and writer who guides Ocean Mind Sangha, a mostly online Zen community. She trained full time for twenty-three years, between 1995 and 2018, at Zen Mountain Monastery in the state of New York, fourteen of them as a monk, and in 2018 received dharma transmission from the monastery's abbot, Geoffrey Shugen Arnold Roshi; her first teacher there was John Daido Loori. After the monastery she began teaching online from New York City, later moved to Playa del Carmen in Mexico, and now lives and receives students in Panama City.

Her teaching centres on zazen, koan study and the bodhisattva path, applied to work, relationships and everyday life. Through the sangha she leads an hour of silent sitting online each day, a Wednesday evening talk with zazen, half-day sits and day-long zazenkai with private interviews, and live study classes on Buddhist texts, with a thirty-day ango intensive. She also meets people for private teaching and takes on formal students. She has served as teachings editor at Tricycle, writes for Buddhist magazines and her books include a guide to moving meditation, Still Running, and a children's book, Weather Any Storm.

courses.title: Private Teaching with Vanessa Zuisei Goddard
courses.description: One-to-one sessions with Zuisei on meditation, Buddhist study and bringing practice into daily life, starting with a free introductory conversation; regular sessions come with becoming a practising student of the sangha.

courses.title: Half-Day Sit (8 am–12 pm EST)
courses.description: A morning of online zazen with the sangha, with the chance of a short private interview (daisan) with Zuisei.

courses.title: Class: The Paramitas or How to Be Compassion in Action
courses.description: A day-long zazenkai and class on the six perfections of the bodhisattva path, open to all and required for those preparing to take the precepts.

courses.title: Half-Day Sit (8 am–12 pm EST), January
courses.description: A further online half-day sit with Ocean Mind Sangha, with zazen and optional daisan with Zuisei.

courses.title: Zen Training: Becoming a Student
courses.description: Two paths of deeper commitment with Zuisei as teacher, as a formal student or a practising student, built on regular practice, study and private sessions within the sangha.

free_resources.title: Daily Zazen Online
free_resources.description: An open hour of silent sitting on Zoom each day with Zuisei and the sangha, marked by bells and a short closing chant; come for all or part of it.

free_resources.title: How to Meditate
free_resources.description: Beginning instruction in zazen as video and audio, with an introduction to koan practice and a suggested talk on Mu.
